name: EOSR WP-MVP-0002 Stable Final Review

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - eosr/review-wp-mvp-0002-final-bootstrap-v2

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  EOS_ACTOR: chatgpt

jobs:
  review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: {fetch-depth: 0}

      - name: Enter exact corrective baseline
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          BASE_SHA="1d7446308e4f2e2efa6ee57aa52747b938232ec0"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          git fetch origin main eosr/review-wp-mvp-0002-final-bootstrap
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$BASE_SHA"
          git reset --hard "$BASE_SHA"
          test ! -e .github/workflows/eosr-wp-mvp-0002-final-review-bootstrap-v2.yml
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

      - name: Fresh corrected implementation verification
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
          rustup override set 1.95.0
          cargo fmt --all -- --check
          cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
          cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          text=Path('crates/monad-core/src/discovery.rs').read_text()
          assert 'filter_map(Result::ok)' not in text
          assert 'cannot enumerate directory entry: {error}' in text
          assert 'directory_entry_errors_are_preserved_while_valid_entries_sort' in text
          assert '**Status:** IN_REVIEW' in Path('engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0002.md').read_text()
          PY
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

      - name: Materialize accepted final review from reviewed bootstrap
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          git show origin/eosr/review-wp-mvp-0002-final-bootstrap:.github/workflows/eosr-wp-mvp-0002-final-review-bootstrap.yml > /tmp/original-review-bootstrap.yml
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import textwrap
          text=Path('/tmp/original-review-bootstrap.yml').read_text()
          marker="          cat > engineering/reviews/WP-MVP-0002-REVIEW.md <<'EOF'\n"
          start=text.index(marker)+len(marker)
          end=text.index('\n          EOF\n',start)
          review=textwrap.dedent(text[start:end])+'\n'
          Path('engineering/reviews/WP-MVP-0002-REVIEW.md').write_text(review)
          assert '**Decision:** ACCEPTED' in review
          assert 'EOSR-WP-MVP-0002-F001 — RESOLVED' in review
          assert '## Blocking Findings\n\nNone.' in review
          PY

      - name: Stabilize EOS trace and machine projections
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          review=Path('engineering/reviews/WP-MVP-0002-REVIEW.md').read_text()
          assert '**Decision:** ACCEPTED' in review
          assert '**Status:** IN_REVIEW' in Path('engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0002.md').read_text()
          PY
          git status --short
          git diff --stat

      - name: Commit accepted review and prove final stability
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          FINAL_BRANCH="eosr/review-wp-mvp-0002-final"
          allowed='^(engineering/reviews/WP-MVP-0002-REVIEW\.md|\.eos/trace-edges\.tsv|machine/)'
          unexpected="$(git diff --name-only | grep -Ev "$allowed" || true)"
          test -z "$unexpected" || { printf 'Unexpected final review scope:\n%s\n' "$unexpected" >&2; exit 1; }
          git config user.name 'ChatGPT'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add -A
          git commit -m 'docs(eosr): accept WP-MVP-0002 engineering review'
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = "1d7446308e4f2e2efa6ee57aa52747b938232ec0"
          if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$FINAL_BRANCH" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Final review branch exists' >&2; exit 1; fi
          git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$FINAL_BRANCH"
